title: Emirates Drug Establishment marks UAE Flag Day, reaffirms loyalty to nation and leadership
summary: Dr Wedad Buhumaid: UAE flag stands for a union strengthened by unity and driven forward by solidarity

The Emirates Drug Establishment (EDE) celebrated UAE Flag Day, observed annually on 3 November. Image courtesy: EDE

Dr Wedad Buhumaid: UAE flag stands for a union strengthened by unity and driven forward by solidarity

Press Release

Dubai, UAE, The Emirates Drug Establishment (EDE) celebrated UAE Flag Day, observed annually on 3 November, with a ceremony during which Her Excellency Dr Fatima Al Kaabi, Director-General of EDE, raised the UAE flag alongside members of the Establishment's team.

The ceremony was held in an atmosphere of national pride, celebrating the UAE flag and the values of unity, solidarity and belonging that bring together everyone living in the country under one flag.

Dr Wedad Buhumaid, Director of the Communication and Marketing Department at the Emirates Drug Establishment, said Flag Day is a cherished national occasion to honour the legacy of the founding fathers, who laid the foundations of the Union and established a nation that made unity a source of strength, solidarity among its people a cornerstone of its progress, and investment in people an enduring principle of its development journey. 

These foundations, she noted, have paved the way for the gains and achievements that have strengthened the UAE's reputation among nations.

Buhumaid added: "The UAE flag is more than a banner raised high. It is a symbol of our nation's sovereignty and pride, a testament to the history of an enduring Union, and a renewed pledge of loyalty to our wise leadership and commitment to safeguarding our nation's achievements and continuing its journey of development and progress.” 

"At the Emirates Drug Establishment, these national values drive our commitment to fulfilling our responsibilities in protecting public health, strengthening pharmaceutical security and establishing a leading pharmaceutical system that keeps pace with the 

UAE's aspirations and future ambitions. We firmly believe that dedication to work and excellence in service are the highest expressions of loyalty to our nation and devotion to its flag."
